idea: WhatsApp Business API bot that sends reminders 24 h before the visit and understands 'yes/no' replies in Kazakh and Russian; cancelled slots are written back to the Google Sheet.
plan: Week 1–2: sheet sync + message templates; week 3–4: reply handling and slot release; week 5–6: pilot with 2 doctors; week 7–8: rollout and report.

idea: Go service on the clinic server with an SMS gateway; only phone + time leave the server, all names stay in the sheet.
plan: Week 1: data model and sheet reader; week 2–3: SMS sending and retries; week 4–5: reply parsing; week 6: security review and pilot.

idea: Per-SKU demand forecast (Prophet) from the 12-month 1C export plus a mobile count form; order = forecast − stock, rounded to pack size.
plan: Week 1: clean CSV and build baseline forecast; week 2: count form; week 3: suggestion page; week 4–5: pilot in one store; week 6: all three stores.

idea: Mobile-first React app for the evening count with a simple moving-average order suggestion.
plan: Week 1–2: count UI; week 3: CSV import; week 4: suggestion page; week 5–6: polish.
rejectReason: We need a forecast based on the sales history, not just a moving average; the count UI looked great though.

idea: Python script reads the evening Excel and sends each driver a Telegram message with the ordered stops at 07:00; dispatcher can re-send from a tiny web page.
plan: Week 1: Excel parsing and driver mapping; week 2: Telegram bot; week 3: dispatcher page; week 4: pilot with 5 drivers.
